top_choice_rationale: Pynchon's major novels provide the strongest available whole-oeuvre case: linguistic energy, structural invention, comic force, historical imagination and inquiry into systems of power are made inseparable elements of a sustained transformation of the modern novel. The later oeuvre requires fuller corpus-level assessment, but the supplied evidence still makes this the most secure literary-achievement claim.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile.
